text:
elaine_runtime: heads-up: planning to push quant-kernel v2.4.1 to canary. binary signed but want sig verification gating before 10% traffic. target start 23:10 UTC. any concerns?
kevin_ops: include provenance hash + builder image tag please. last time a stray toolchain bumped cold starts.
elaine_runtime: will do — metadata uploaded to artifact-store. snippet: `sha256:abcdef1234567890...` image: `rdrw-builder:2026-03-19`
maya_build: buildbot: artifact uploaded and signed (gpg:0xC0FFE3D). verified locally. pushing tag `canary-v2-4-1`. int4 path disabled on canary per QA.
deploybot: ```
preflight: kernel-abi=stable
qconfig=conf-xg1
signatures=ok
health-checks=passing
```
sam_sre: what are the canary gates? define success criteria for cpu/mem/coldstart so alerts can be tuned.
elaine_runtime: keep it tight: p90 latency <= 120ms, error-rate increase < 0.5% absolute, coldstart increase < 3% relative. telemetry: /telemetry/canary/v2.4.1. notify if any model-output drift detected.
kevin_ops: add retention & pin policy: if rolling >1h or any fallback occurs, auto-pin to previous kernel. make sure deploybot can auto-pin `v2.4.0-kernel` on rollback.
maya_build: QA: quant sanity passed for float32->int8. int4 flaky on long sequences -> disabled on canary. stress tests in staging passed.
sam_sre: propose rollout steps: 2% -> 5% -> 20% with 15m holds. automated rollback if thresholds breach. I'll own on-call for first 45m.
deploybot: rollout plan created: ```
deploybot create-rollout --artifact canary-v2-4-1 --steps 2%,5%,20% --hold 15m --rollback-on "error_rate>0.5 OR p90>120ms OR coldstart_increase>3%"
```
elaine_runtime: starting canary at 23:10 UTC. I will annotate runbook with `rollback: immediate pin to v2.4.0-kernel` and contact @oncall on first sign of regression.
qa-bot: smoke results: model-inference ok, kvcache regen ok, long-run memory ok in staging. int4 disabled as requested.
deploybot: canary started at 1953210060 (23:10 UTC). current rollout: 2% traffic -> 12 hosts.
sam_sre: dashboards/alerts are live: canary-latency-spike, canary-error-rate, coldstart-regression. will monitor first 45m.
kevin_ops: note: if we see >2x coldstart or non-deterministic outputs, rollback immediately and capture full core dumps + logs. watch `serve/coldstart` and `kernel/kv-regen`.
deploybot: update @channel: metrics stable after first hold. promoting to 5% now.
elaine_runtime: thanks all. will wait full 1h then decide. if clean, schedule broad rollout in off-hours tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
sam_sre: :thumbsup:"
